records.text: New signup alert -- *North Systems* just created a workspace on starter.

decisions.rationale: Six days in with no first project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero replies to either outreach ([email:9125801b], [email:c62e2fdf]) or tickets filed. No signal of engagement, so unaided activation in the remaining 8 days is unlikely though not impossible.

draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield?
draft.body:
Hi Rosa,

Checking back in on North Systems. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, so creating a first project is usually the step that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

If it's easier, I'm happy to walk through setting up that first project with you on a short call this week -- just reply with a time that suits and I'll work around you.

Best,
Nadia
